value.rationale: The dependence between fair order choices is an intrinsic design degree of freedom at fixed per-block evaluation cost. The exact optimal coupling changes twice with step size, including a switch within the individual-step elliptic range, while only one finite resonant step cancels all block energy growth. This distinguishes marginal symplectic/eigenvalue stability from randomized expected-energy stability and gives a sharp benchmark for order-pairing strategies, beyond a routine deterministic expansion.
